title: loadRouter
summary: Load a server route before rendering.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: routes contains server route modules. input is an absolute URL string or a Request.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Promise resolving to a request-scoped Router whose initial navigation has completed.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.
sections.code:
const router = await loadRouter(routes, request);
const snapshot = router.getSnapshot();

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Server execution ignores clientLoader and clientAction. A Request forwards headers and combines its abort signal with router cancellation. Handle response status and redirects in your server adapter. Client-only loader routes produce a fallback snapshot for hydration.
